shared_elements: elongated linear objects held by figures (weapon-like/bow-like forms)
multiple figures grouped along the upper part of the field
justification: Both show human figures with raised arms holding elongated linear implements, which is a generic and easily independent correspondence; A additionally depicts a detailed architectural scene with a crenellated wall, gate, siege engine on wheels, and archers in profile drawing bows, none of which appears in B. B shows only isolated, crudely outlined frontal-ish stick-like figures with no setting, no architecture and no narrative combination, so beyond the vague 'figure with arms up holding a line' there is no shared iconographic scheme.
